name: Kanibar
author: erfoip
description: WaniKani reviews and lessons in your bar, with a popup for level progress, SRS stages, the review forecast and an optional daily reminder.

barWidget.description: Pending WaniKani reviews and lessons. Click for level progress, SRS stages and the forecast; middle-click refreshes.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes, 0 = off)
schema.description: How often the bar counts are fetched in the background. Kanibar also refreshes just after each full hour, when new reviews unlock. 0 turns background refresh off; opening the popup or middle-clicking still refreshes.

schema.label: Hide when nothing is due
schema.description: Hide the bar pill while it would only show the done check: no reviews, and no lessons or lessons hidden from the bar.

schema.label: Highlight at reviews
schema.description: Color the pill with the urgent color once this many reviews are waiting. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Daily review reminder
schema.description: Send a notification at the time below if reviews are still waiting. If the computer is asleep then, it reminds you on wake (until midnight).

schema.label: Remind at reviews
schema.description: Only remind when at least this many reviews are waiting.

schema.label: Command that opens links
schema.description: Run with the link as its last argument, e.g. omarchy-launch-webapp. In shell.json it can also be a list of words for a command with arguments.
